outcome: Histopathological confirmation of mature cystic teratoma
cohort: A single 32-year-old woman, gravida 4 para 3, 38 weeks and 5 days pregnant, undergoing an emergency lower segment cesarean section.
finding: An asymptomatic parasitic teratoma and left-sided adnexa agenesis were incidentally discovered during a cesarean section in a 38-week and 5-day pregnant woman.
mod_finding: The parasitic teratoma was discovered incidentally during an emergency lower segment cesarean section.
